title: Docs lookup in all three vocabularies: the tool's own terms, a known tool's terms, and task language, one topic

steps.step: Vocabulary one, the tool's own terms. The agent already knows the operator name and asks for it directly.

response.summary: $group collapses the documents reaching it into one output document per distinct _id value. _id is required and names the grouping key; every other field of the output is an accumulator over the documents in that group. _id: null groups everything into a single document.
